name: Joinn Laboratories(China)Co.,Ltd.
summary: Joinn Laboratories(China)Co.,Ltd. provides preclinical and non-clinical services in the United States, the People's Republic of China, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Non-Clinical Studies Services; Clinical Trial and Related Services; and Sales of Research Models. The Non-Clinical Studies Services segment offers drug safety assessment, drug metabolism and pharmacokinetics DMPK studies, and pharmacology and efficacy studies. Its Clinical Trial and Related Services segment provide clinical contract research organization services, co-managed phase I clinical research units, and bioanalytical services.
